# Joint equal-group-between FE–RE Hausman controls

Generated by `examples/mma24p1olscluster/household_hausman_synthetic.R` and
`household_hausman_reference.R` with R4.6.2. Original publisher data is not
bundled. Inputs use short exact dyadic source tokens, avoiding cross-language
17-digit decimal parsing ambiguity; all original source fields remain exact.

- Balanced:192 rows,32 groups of6.
- Unbalanced:200 source/199 selected rows,32 groups, one singleton; source
  row4 has missing outcome and finite predictors/group key.

Both designs include six full-rank numeric slopes and intercept, strong
between-group regressor information and within-group noise. Independent R
within QR/full-dummy QR and equal-group-between/quasi-GLS QR validate both full
slope covariances and their difference. Native FE and RE covariance scales are
kept separate, not forced to a common variance. The reference refuses a
nonpositive Cholesky factor; no absolute quadratic or generalized inverse.

Each `*_reference.csv` contains139 numeric JSON-path gates: sample/group counts,
DF/scales, scaled minimum Cholesky pivot, statistic/p, both slope vectors,
differences and all entries of three6x6 covariance matrices. Prediction files
contain all selected source fields and population RE xb/residuals.

The separate native helper tests supply indefinite/singular/cancellation-
dominated differences even when both parent covariances are SPD and diagonal
differences are positive. The older household RE interior and BP balanced
fixtures also yielded indefinite differences in R probes; they are not valid
positive-Hausman references and were not made to pass by changing scales or
tolerances. Rejection coverage for these actual fits remains part of integration
verification before the complete slice is merged.

Regenerate into a new directory:

```sh
Rscript examples/mma24p1olscluster/household_hausman_synthetic.R /tmp/new-joint-hausman "$PWD/examples/mma24p1olscluster/household_hausman_reference.R"
```

Map `case/input.csv` to `case_input.csv`, and
`case/reference/{reference,predictions}.csv` to `case_kind.csv`. R/Python remain
optional development reference tools, not production dependencies.
